problem.title: Prescription Adherence Active Patient Periods
problem.prompt: A pharmacy tracks prescription refill adherence. The `patients` table lists enrolled patients (patient_id, patient_name). The `prescriptions` table logs each prescription issued (prescription_id, patient_id, start_date, end_date NULLABLE) where end_date is NULL if the prescription is still active. Write a query to produce a monthly report for Q1 2024 (January through March) showing how many prescriptions were active for each patient in each month. A prescription is considered active in a month if it overlaps that month at all: issued by the end of the month (start_date < first day of next month) AND not yet ended before the month starts (end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= first day of the month). Return columns (patient_id, month_start, active_count) where month_start is the first day of each Q1 2024 month and active_count is the count of prescriptions active for that patient in that month. Include all patients in every month, even if they had 0 active prescriptions. Order by patient_id, then month_start.
problem.schema_ddl: CREATE TABLE patients (patient_id INT PRIMARY KEY, patient_name VARCHAR(100)); CREATE TABLE prescriptions (prescription_id INT PRIMARY KEY, patient_id INT, start_date DATE, end_date DATE);
problem.example_input_data: INSERT INTO patients (patient_id, patient_name) VALUES (1, 'Alice Johnson'), (2, 'Bob Martinez'), (3, 'Carol Lee'); INSERT INTO prescriptions (prescription_id, patient_id, start_date, end_date) VALUES (101, 1, '2023-12-15', '2024-01-20'), (102, 1, '2024-01-25', NULL), (103, 2, '2024-02-01', '2024-02-28'), (104, 3, '2024-01-10', '2024-03-15'), (105, 3, '2024-03-01', '2024-03-10');

composite_moves: generate_series date spine for Q1 2024 months
CROSS JOIN spine with patients dim
LEFT JOIN prescriptions with overlap predicate in ON clause
COUNT(prescription_id) to get active_count with zero-fill

hints: Build a date spine for Q1 2024 months, then combine it with all patients to create every (patient, month) cell.
Use a LEFT JOIN from the (patient, month) spine to prescriptions with an overlap condition: the prescription started before the month ended AND either hasn't ended or ended during/after the month.

The overlap predicate must check: start_date < month_start + INTERVAL '1 month' AND (end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= month_start). Use COUNT(prescription_id) after the LEFT JOIN to count active prescriptions, which will be 0 for patients with no overlapping prescriptions in that month.
problem.answer_key:
WITH months AS (
  SELECT generate_series(DATE '2024-01-01', DATE '2024-03-01', INTERVAL '1 month')::date AS month_start
),
patient_months AS (
  SELECT p.patient_id, m.month_start
  FROM patients p
  CROSS JOIN months m
)
SELECT
  pm.patient_id,
  pm.month_start,
  COUNT(pr.prescription_id)::int AS active_count
FROM patient_months pm
LEFT JOIN prescriptions pr
  ON pr.patient_id = pm.patient_id
 AND pr.start_date < pm.month_start + INTERVAL '1 month'
 AND (pr.end_date IS NULL OR pr.end_date >= pm.month_start)
GROUP BY pm.patient_id, pm.month_start
ORDER BY pm.patient_id, pm.month_start;

_meta.scenario: a prescription refill adherence program tracking 30/60/90 day refill rates

user_solution:
/* notes */

WITH spine AS (
    SELECT
        p.patient_id,
        d.month_start
    FROM (
        SELECT generate_series(
                '2024-01-01'::date,
                '2024-03-01'::date,
                INTERVAL '1 month'
                )::date AS month_start
        ) AS d
    CROSS JOIN patients AS p
)
SELECT
    s.patient_id,
    s.month_start,
    COUNT(p.prescription_id) AS active_count
FROM spine AS s
LEFT JOIN prescriptions AS p
    ON s.patient_id = p.patient_id
    AND p.start_date < s.month_start + INTERVAL '1 month'
    AND (p.end_date IS NULL OR p.end_date >= s.month_start)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2;
